attempted_claim: Let M be a countable saturated o-minimal expansion of a real closed field and let Phi(x;y) be a finite set of formulas with |x|=3. Does Phi admit, for every epsilon>0, a distal cell decomposition T with |T(B)|=O_{Phi,epsilon}(|B|^{3+epsilon}) for all finite nonempty B subset M^{|y|} — i.e., is the distal density of Phi at most 3?
